inlines.v: SLASH, verb transitive 1. To cut by striking violently and at random; to cut in long cuts. 2. To lash. SLASH, verb intransitive To strike violently and at random with a sword, hanger or other edger instrument; to lay about one with blows. Hewing and slashing at their idle shades. SLASH, noun A long cut; a cut made at random.
